mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 600K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 600K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, stimulating equity markets and yielding positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) declines by > 0.5pp in 2 months, signaling labor market strength, S&P 500 forward returns are likely to be positive over the next 60 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broadening economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST are rising.

mechanism_narrative: A > 5% monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is below 210, indicating contained inflation, S&P 500 forward returns are likely to be positive over the next 60 trading days due to reduced discount rates.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during trigger conditions are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) to below 9% signals a labor market turnaround, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate economic recovery.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when UNRATE first falls below 9%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: GDP growth (GDPC1) above 1% quarterly signals a growing economy, consistently leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.
